## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows `feat|fix|docs|chore|refactor|test/<slug>` convention
- [ ] Each commit follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] Each commit is DCO-signed (`git commit -s`)

- [ ] Docs added or updated (`README.md`, `docs/`, OpenAPI summary…)
- [ ] No new runtime dependency without a one-line rationale
- [ ] No secret / personal data in the diff
